notes: 3.16.0 got the direction wrong. It defaulted hand lists and shipped examples to *ineligible* — which is automatic exclusion by another name: a cohort silently dropped from a member's decomposition because of its kind, not because anyone decided it didn't belong. That is precisely what a per-cohort choice is supposed to prevent. Corrected: inclusion and exclusion are both deliberate choices, and nothing is excluded automatically. Every cohort participates in the decomposition by default. The only thing that removes one is an explicit exclusion you make — reversible at any time. A migrated watch
